title: banksia dolichostyla
intro: Banksia dolichostyla, commonly known as the Eastern Banksia, is a flowering plant species within the Banksia genus. It is native to New South Wales and Queensland in Australia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in Banksia dolichostyla include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antiproliferative activities.
